record.field: Grow revenue sustainably across the whole clinic network
revenue, growth, network, clinic chain, dental chair

field.name: description
field.p: The growth direction of the whole network for the quarter: increase revenue through better consultations and high-value services, not through discounts. A good company-level OKR for every clinic to align with.

record.field: Increase network-wide net revenue per quarter
Total revenue collected after discounts across all clinics, taken from the month-end financial report (quarter to date).
Increase average monthly revenue per dental chair
Monthly clinic revenue divided by the number of active dental chairs; averaged across the network.
Raise the treatment plan acceptance rate
Treatment plans accepted by patients (deposit paid or treatment started) / total plans presented during the month.
Increase the number of implant cases per month
Number of implant placements performed (counted per fixture), as recorded in the clinic management software.
Become the most trusted orthodontic clinic in the area
orthodontics, braces, clear aligners, invisalign, brackets

field.name: description
field.p: For clinics or orthodontic teams that want a breakthrough in new orthodontic cases through a professional consultation experience and transparent before/after results.

record.field: Increase new orthodontic cases per month
Number of new orthodontic contracts signed (deposit paid) during the month.
Raise the orthodontic consultation → signed contract conversion rate
Contracts signed / patients who received an in-person orthodontic consultation during the month.
Increase the average value of an orthodontic contract
Total value of new orthodontic contracts / number of new contracts during the month.
Every patient receives the most comprehensive and suitable treatment
treatment plan, patient value, upsell, comprehensive care

field.name: description
field.p: Increase the treatment value per patient through thorough examinations, comprehensive treatment plans and follow-through until completion, instead of only fixing the immediate problem.

record.field: Increase the average treatment value per patient
Treatment revenue for the month / number of patients treated during the month.
Raise the share of patients who complete their full treatment plan
Treatment plans completed / plans due for completion during the quarter.
Increase comprehensive treatment plans presented per month
Number of comprehensive treatment plans (with images, costs and timeline) presented by dentists and saved in the software.
Become the treatment consultant patients trust most in the clinic
treatment consultant, plan closing, individual, sales

field.name: description
field.p: Individual OKR for treatment consultants / treatment coordinators: caring advice, transparent costs and close follow-up until the patient decides.

record.field: Raise my personal treatment plan closing rate
Patients who accept treatment / patients you consulted during the month (from the CRM).
Number of consultations with complete notes in the CRM.
Increase monthly treatment sales from successful consultations
Total value of accepted treatment plans from your consultations.
Deliver a dental experience patients want to recommend to their loved ones
NPS, experience, Google, rating, referral, review

field.name: description
field.p: An experience beyond expectations is the cheapest and most durable growth engine: satisfied patients come back and refer new ones.

record.field: Post-treatment survey (Zalo/SMS): % of patients scoring 9–10 minus % scoring 0–6. At least 200 responses per month.
Average rating on the Google Business Profile of all clinics at the end of the quarter.
Increase new Google reviews per month
Number of new reviews on the Google Business Profiles of the whole network during the month.
Increase the share of new patients coming from referrals
New patients with the source "Referred by an acquaintance" / total new patients during the month.
Every complaint is heard and resolved quickly and with care

field.name: description
field.p: A well-handled complaint can turn an unhappy patient into a loyal advocate.

record.field: Reduce the average complaint resolution time
From receipt until the complaint ticket is closed (confirmed by the patient), monthly average.
Increase the share of complaints answered within 2 hours
Complaints with a first response ≤ 2 hours / total complaints received.
Raise patient satisfaction after complaint handling
Short survey after the ticket is closed: satisfied patients / patients who responded.
Retain patients with a thoughtful periodic care program
recall, check-up, no-show, return visit, appointment reminder

field.name: description
field.p: Patients returning for regular check-ups are the foundation of long-term oral health and steady clinic revenue.

record.field: Patients who came for their check-up during the period / patients due for their 6-month check-up during the period.
Appointments missed without prior notice / total appointments during the month.
Call patients within 48 hours after treatment
Patients with a post-treatment call ≤ 48 hours (logged in the CRM) / patients who had invasive treatment.
Every care call is a warm and helpful experience
call, CSAT, call center, patient care, individual

field.name: description
field.p: Individual OKR for customer care / call center staff.

record.field: Increase completed care calls per week
Number of successfully connected calls with notes in the call center system / CRM.
Automatic post-call survey score, monthly average.
Increase the share of calls that result in a recall appointment
Appointments booked from care calls / connected care calls.
Uncompromising clinical safety standards in every clinic
sterilization, safety, infection control, disinfection, medical records

field.name: description
field.p: Patient safety is a non-negotiable commitment: infection control, complete records and zero serious incidents.

record.field: Raise the infection control and sterilization compliance audit score
Monthly infection control and sterilization audit score based on the internal checklist, averaged across clinics.
Bring serious clinical incidents down to zero
Number of severe incidents reported during the quarter (according to the incident reporting procedure).
Medical records complete with diagnosis, signatures and treatment consent
Random check of 30 records per clinic per month: compliant records / records checked.
Raise implant treatment quality to international standards
implant, implantology, CBCT, surgical guide, quality

field.name: description
field.p: For implant centers: consistent clinical outcomes, digital treatment planning and fewer re-interventions.

record.field: Raise the successful osseointegration rate at 6 months
Implants well integrated at the 6-month check-up / total implants due for assessment.
Increase the share of implant cases planned digitally (CBCT + surgical guide)
Cases with a digital plan saved in the record / total implant cases during the month.
Cases requiring re-intervention (removal, fixture replacement, additional grafting) within 12 months / total cases.
Develop outstanding clinical expertise and earn patients' affection
dentist, CME, continuing education, case review, individual

field.name: description
field.p: Individual OKR for dentists: continuous learning, sharing clinical cases and raising patient satisfaction.

record.field: Total certified hours from courses, conferences or internal training during the quarter.
Present clinical cases at internal case reviews
Number of cases presented with case review minutes on file.
Raise patient satisfaction with the dentist
Post-treatment survey: satisfied responses / total responses about the dentist.
Complete an advanced certification (implant, orthodontics or cosmetic dentistry)
Achieved when the certificate is issued during the quarter.
Attract a steady flow of new patients at an optimal cost
lead, CPL, conversion, new patients, advertising

field.name: description
field.p: The core OKR of the Marketing team: more qualified leads, converted into actual appointments.

record.field: Leads with a valid phone number and a clear dental need, recorded in the CRM.
Total advertising spend for the month / number of qualified leads.
Raise the lead → appointment conversion rate
Leads who booked an appointment / total qualified leads during the month.
Patients visiting for the first time (new record created) across the network.
Build the most loved dental brand on social media
brand, fanpage, TikTok, content, social media, branding

field.name: description
field.p: A friendly, trustworthy brand built on oral health education content and real patient stories.

record.field: Total likes, comments and shares / number of posts on Facebook and TikTok during the month.
Increase new followers during the quarter
New followers on the official channels (Facebook, TikTok, Zalo OA).
Videos made with the patient's consent and posted on the official channels during the quarter.
Every marketing dollar brings in real patients

field.name: description
field.p: Optimize the budget: measure everything from ads to revenue, cut underperforming channels and focus on the channels that bring patients.

record.field: Reduce the cost of acquiring a new patient (CAC)
Total marketing spend for the month / number of new patients who visited.
Revenue from patients sourced from ads / corresponding advertising spend.
Appointments from leads where the patient showed up / total appointments from leads.
Run the clinic smoothly and on time, without keeping patients waiting
waiting time, chair utilization, appointments, punctuality, operations

field.name: description
field.p: Patients judge the clinic from the moment they walk in: punctuality and short waits are the minimum expected experience.

record.field: Reduce the average patient waiting time
From check-in at reception until the patient is seated in the chair, monthly average from the software.
Chair hours with treatment / total open chair hours during the month.
Increase appointments starting on time (±10 minutes)
Appointments starting within 10 minutes of the scheduled time / total appointments.
Supplies always ready for treatment, with no waste

field.name: description
field.p: A well-controlled supply stock lets dentists treat with peace of mind and lowers clinic costs.

record.field: No more treatments postponed for lack of essential supplies
Number of treatment appointments rescheduled due to missing supplies, recorded in the monthly operations report.
Reduce the value of expired or damaged supplies per quarter
Total value of supplies written off according to the end-of-quarter stock count report.
Reduce the supply cost to revenue ratio
Total consumable supply cost / treatment revenue for the month.
Expand the clinic network with a standardized, replicable model
expansion, new clinic, standardization, replication, opening

field.name: description
field.p: Every new clinic meets the same quality standard and breaks even quickly thanks to a standardized operating model.

record.field: Clinics opening on the approved opening date.
Increase the share of clinics passing the internal operations audit
Clinics scoring ≥ 85 on the operations audit / total clinics.
Shorten the break-even time of new clinics
Break-even forecast from the financial plan, updated every quarter.
Build an engaged, proud and ever-growing team

field.name: description
field.p: A happy team creates a great patient experience. Reducing turnover and investing in training are top priorities.

record.field: Employees who left over the last 12 months / average headcount.
Quarterly anonymous survey: % of employees scoring 9–10 minus % scoring 0–6.
Increase average training hours per employee during the quarter
Total recorded training hours / average headcount for the quarter.
New hires integrate quickly and work confidently from their first month
onboarding, integration, new hire, SOP, dental assistant

field.name: description
field.p: Standardize the onboarding program for new dental assistants, receptionists and dentists to retain top talent from day one.

record.field: New hires complete the onboarding program within 30 days
New hires who completed all onboarding modules within 30 days / total new hires.
Raise the end-of-probation skills assessment score (out of 100)
Average score of the skills assessment at the end of the probation period.
Reduce the share of new hires leaving within their first 90 days
Employees leaving within their first 90 days / new hires during the period.
Publish the dental assistant training SOP set
Achieved when the SOP set is approved and rolled out to all clinics.
Become the dream workplace for young dentists

field.name: description
field.p: Attract great dentists through a strong employer brand, a clear career path and a professional hiring process.

record.field: Reduce the time to hire a dentist
From the day the position opens until the candidate accepts, averaged over positions filled during the quarter.
Raise the job offer acceptance rate
Maintain a pipeline of qualified dentist candidates
Candidates who passed the clinical screening round and are in the pipeline at month end.
Strong financial health as a foundation for growth
EBITDA, profit, costs, receivables, AR days

field.name: description
field.p: Growth must come with healthy profits and cash flow so the network can invest in expansion with confidence.

record.field: EBITDA / net revenue according to the quarterly management report.
Reduce the operating expense to revenue ratio
Total operating expenses (excluding depreciation) / net revenue.
Reduce average accounts receivable days (AR days)
Average accounts receivable / average daily revenue (including installments and insurance).
Tight, transparent control of cash flow and receivables
cash flow, receivables, installments, closing, payment

field.name: description
field.p: For the Accounting & Finance team: collect receivables on time, close the books quickly and digitize payments.

record.field: Reduce the overdue installment receivables rate
Installment receivables overdue by more than 30 days / total installment receivables.
Shorten the monthly accounting close (working days)
Working days from month end until the management report is issued.
Increase the share of cashless payments
Amount collected by bank transfer, card or e-wallet / total amount collected during the month.
digital transformation, electronic records, EMR, online booking, Zalo OA

field.name: description
field.p: From booking, examination and treatment to aftercare, everything runs on a digital platform: more convenient for patients and more efficient for the team.

record.field: Cover every visit with an electronic medical record (EMR)
Visits with a complete electronic record / total visits during the month.
Increase the share of appointments booked online
Appointments booked through the website, Zalo OA or the app / total appointments.
Increase the share of patients receiving reminders via Zalo OA or the app
Active patients connected to Zalo OA / the app / total active patients.
Make faster decisions with real-time data

field.name: description
field.p: Management and clinic managers look at the same up-to-date figures, with no more waiting for manual reports.

record.field: Launch a real-time KPI dashboard for the whole network
Achieved when the dashboard is signed off and every clinic manager has access.
Clinic managers use the KPI report every week
Managers who open the dashboard each week / total clinic managers.
Shorten the time to produce the monthly operations report
Time from month end until the operations report is sent to management.
Reliable systems and patient data that is always fully protected
security, uptime, information security, patient data

field.name: description
field.p: Health data is a sensitive asset: a stable infrastructure and a security culture are everyone's responsibility.

record.field: Total uptime of the clinic management software / total time in the month (from the monitoring tool).
Bring data security incidents down to zero
Number of data leaks or unauthorized access incidents recorded during the quarter.
Employees complete the information security training
Employees who passed the final course test / total employees.
